newsitem.title: USA: Racotek sets Internet-based computing lab.
newsitem.headline: Racotek sets Internet-based computing lab.

text.p: Racotek Inc said Wednesday it launched a Wireless Computing Lab service that allows programmers to contact the company through the Internet.
The company said developers can set up, use and evaluate wireless data networking on their existing corporate networks by linking to Racotek through several Internet networks.
Racotek is offering the entire Wireless Computing Lab package to developers for an undisclosed amount.
Racotek provides software and mobile data systems.
Its shares were off 1/4 Wednesday afternoon at 3-1/2.
